hero.title: The Polygood® Kitchen Edit
hero.subtitle: The life of a worktop, from the workshop to the next refit, told in four kitchens.
hero.intro: This edition follows one worktop through its life in four chapters: shaped in the workshop, fitted in the kitchen, lived in every day and renewed at the next refit. Each chapter is a real kitchen in Polygood® and shows what the material does at that stage.
hero.image_alt: Close-ups from four Polygood projects: a wave-cut Terrazzo Nuovo worktop edge, an Emerald Ghost table, a White Lollipop worktop and a Timeless Duo Blue countertop

headline: Kitchens, and the makers behind them
intro: This edition follows one worktop through its life in four chapters: shaped in the workshop, fitted in the kitchen, lived in every day and renewed at the next refit. Each chapter is a real kitchen in Polygood® and shows what the material does at that stage.

cases.title: Thermoformed kitchen
cases.headline: The curve
cases.body: Curves are hard in most worktop materials: they are built from pieces, and every joint is a line to keep clean. Samji Studio heated an Emerald Ghost panel until it softened, bent it into a curve and made the table to match. A bend instead of a joint.
cases.image_alt: Emerald Ghost kitchen worktop and matching table in a Paris flat with timber cabinets and herringbone parquet

cases.title: Maison Kyka
cases.headline: The edge
cases.body: On many worktops the front edge is a strip glued over the core, and it is often the first thing to lift. Polygood is solid all the way through and needs no edge protection. Samji Studio made the Terrazzo Nuovo worktops for two Maison Kyka flats, and in one cut the edge into a wave and left it bare.
cases.image_alt: Terrazzo Nuovo worktop with a wave-cut bare front edge above beige cabinets and a wavy timber handle

cases.title: Station Road
cases.headline: Stains and care
cases.body: A white worktop is the one clients hesitate over. In our stain test with 20 everyday agents, most left no trace on Polygood, and a mark that stays can be sanded out. WUNSCH fitted this one in White Lollipop. Daily care is a pH-neutral cleaner, with a trivet for hot pans.
cases.image_alt: White Lollipop worktop with small coloured flecks beside a brass sink, with a cabbage on the counter

cases.title: Commerzbank
cases.headline: Water and the next refit
cases.body: Polygood absorbs no moisture, so in Commerzbank's pantry, designed by CBRE Design Collective, the sink sits under the Timeless Duo Blue countertop with the cut-out edge left bare. When the pantry is refitted, the countertops can come back to us through our take-back programme. Polygood is 100% recyclable.
cases.image_alt: Timeless Duo Blue countertop with an undermount steel sink, blue glazed tiles and teal cabinets in the Commerzbank pantry

partner.heading: Your workshop could write the next chapter
partner.body:
Every kitchen in this story came from a workshop or design studio working with Polygood. We'd like to work with more of them: kitchen studios, cabinetmakers and worktop fabricators, on joint projects.

We support you with samples, our technical guide, adhesive matrix and care guide. When a kitchen is finished, we share it on polygood.com and in this newsletter, credited to the people who made it.
